The startup world seems convinced that we’ll all remake our workflows with AI, but what of our culture — the intangible connective tissue beneath it all? It’s no coincidence that before AI, the best companies often had the best cultures. In fact, not only is it likely this dynamic will continue as AI further takes hold, it will become even more important, argue guest authors Mark Himmelsbach and Remy Pinson in this first installment of a three-part series.
